title: ci-fix output
description: Structured output from the ci-fix skill

summary.description: One-line summary of the failure and fix

failure_line.description: The actual error line extracted from the log

description.description: Explanation of why the failure occurred

env_mismatch.description: Present when the root cause is a CI-vs-local environment difference

is_flaky.description: Whether this is an intermittent/flaky failure

pre_existing.description: Whether this failure predates the current PR

description.description: What was changed to fix the failure

files_changed.description: List of files modified for the fix

workflow_changed.description: Whether CI workflow files were modified

ci_pass.description: Whether the fix passes in CI

ci_run_url.description: URL of the CI run that verified the fix
